{{short description|Italian mathematician}}
[[File:Revelli_-_Elementi_dell'aritmetica_universale_e_della_geometria_piana_e_solida,_1778_-_578390.tif|thumb|''Elementi dell'aritmetica universale e della geometria piana e solida'' (1778)]]
'''Filippo Antonio Revelli''' (1716 – 1801) was an [[Italians|Italian]] [[mathematician]].<ref name="Revelli1918">{{Cite book|author=Paolo Revelli|title=Un maestro del Lagrange: Filippo Antonio Revelli (1716-1801)|location=Genoa|publisher=E. Oliveri|date=1918|language=it}}</ref>

== Life ==
He was professor of [[geometry]] for 26 years at the [[University of Turin]].<ref>{{Cite book|author=M. Boisset fils|title=Lettre contenant l'histoire, et un essai d'analyse des eaux de La Boisse|date=1779|location=Turin|publisher=Jean-Michel Briolo|page=71|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=BSXA0lqG2XkC&pg=PT2|language=fr}}</ref>

He had among his pupils [[Joseph-Louis Lagrange]].<ref name="Revelli1918" /><ref name="Bollettino">{{Cite book|title=Bollettino della Società piemontese di archeologia e belle arti|date=1917|publisher=Società piemontese di archeologia e belle arti|location=Turin|page=101|url=https://archive.org/details/cfi0348186_xxxxx_bI-bII_0000001/page/n561/mode/2up|language=it}}</ref>

His son Vincenzo Antonio Revelli (1764-1835) was a philosopher and painter.<ref>{{Cite book|author=[[Vittorio Spreti]]|title=Enciclopedia storico-nobiliare italiana|volume=5|date=1935|location=Bologna|publisher=Forni|page=662|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=BSgbAAAAYAAJ|language=it}}</ref><ref name="Bollettino" />
